recipes.title: Homemade Dumpling Wrappers

steps.text: Gradually add the water to the flour and knead about 10 minutes to a smooth dough. Cover with a damp cloth and rest 1 hour.
Divide into 48 pieces and roll each into a 9 cm (3 1/2 inch) circle. Keep covered as you work.

reviewNotes: 48 wrappers; one serving = one wrapper so the dumpling recipe can reference 48.
No salt in the dough per source.

recipes.title: Chicken and Shiitake Dumplings

ingredients.original: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms, reconstituted and chopped
2 tbsp Shaoxing wine (or dry cooking sherry)

steps.text: Soak the dried shiitake in cold water overnight, or in hot water about 2 hours weighted with a small plate. Squeeze, trim stems, chop. Keep the liquid for stock.
Heat 2 tbsp oil over medium and cook the onion until translucent. Add the fresh and soaked mushrooms and cook 8 to 10 minutes.
Transfer to a bowl with the ground chicken, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, Shaoxing wine and 3 tbsp oil. Stir in one direction about 5 minutes until paste-like.

makeAhead.note: filling can be made the day before

steps.text: Put about 1 heaping tablespoon of filling on each wrapper, pleat and seal (dab water on the edge for store-bought wrappers). Line up on a parchment-lined tray.

makeAhead.note: freeze spaced on the tray until solid, then bag; cook from frozen

steps.text: Pan-fry: heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high, fry until the bottoms are lightly golden, add water 1/4 inch deep, cover until it evaporates, then uncover and fry until golden brown. Or boil 7 to 8 minutes.
Garnish with green onion and serve with chili oil, vinegar or dumpling sauce.

reviewNotes: Source card says 3 hours prep, which includes the dough rest and may not cover the 2-hour mushroom soak. Set 90 min active prep; the soak is a lead-time step.
Filling per dumpling: article says 1 heaping tbsp, card says 2 tbsp. Used 1 heaping.
Pan-frying oil was in the steps but not the list; merged into the oil line.
No freezer shelf life given; 3 months per the FoodKeeper default for frozen dumplings.
Tagged component so a dumpling soup can reference it; store-bought frozen dumplings satisfy the same line.
